description.it: Esporre un deployment come Service interno
description.en: Expose a deployment as internal Service

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment nginx con 2 repliche
2. Esponi come Service ClusterIP su porta 80
3. Verifica che il Service abbia un IP del cluster
4. Testa la connettività con un pod di test
hints: Usa un pod busybox per wget
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment nginx --image=nginx --replicas=2
kubectl expose deployment nginx --port=80 --target-port=80
kubectl get svc nginx
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- nginx

description.it: Esporre un'applicazione su una porta del nodo
description.en: Expose an application on a node port

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment web
2. Esponi come NodePort su porta 30080
3. Verifica che il Service sia accessibile
4. Identifica la porta NodePort assegnata
hints: Per specificare la porta: --nodePort=30080 nel manifest
La NodePort è nella colonna PORT(S)
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment web --type=NodePort --port=80
kubectl get svc web -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}'
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- web

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Service senza selector che punta a 8.8.8.8:53
2. Crea manualmente gli Endpoints
3. Verifica che il Service punti all'IP esterno
4. Testa la risoluzione DNS attraverso il Service
hints: Crea il Service senza selector nel manifest
Crea Endpoints con stesso nome del Service
L'IP degli Endpoints è quello esterno
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: external-dns
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 53
    targetPort: 53
    protocol: UDP
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Endpoints
metadata:
  name: external-dns
subsets:
- addresses:
  - ip: 8.8.8.8
  ports:
  - port: 53
    protocol: UDP
EOF

kubectl describe svc external-dns

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Service my-app nel namespace default
2. Da un pod di test, risolvi il DNS del Service
3. Testa tutte le forme DNS: nome, nome.namespace, FQDN
4. Verifica che l'IP risolto corrisponda al ClusterIP
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment my-app --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment my-app --port=80
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup my-app
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup my-app.default.svc.cluster.local
CLUSTER_IP=$(kubectl get svc my-app -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}') && echo $CLUSTER_IP

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment e Service web
2. Crea un Ingress per myapp.local
3. Verifica che l'Ingress punti al Service
4. Controlla l'indirizzo IP dell'Ingress
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment web --port=80

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web-ingress
spec:
  rules:
  - host: myapp.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: web
            port:
              number: 80
EOF

kubectl get ingress web-ingress

description.it: Instradare percorsi diversi a Service diversi
description.en: Route different paths to different Services

exercises.task:
1. Crea due deployment: frontend e api
2. Crea i rispettivi Service
3. Configura Ingress con /frontend e /api
4. Verifica il routing degli endpoint
hints: Ogni path ha un backend diverso
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment frontend --image=nginx
kubectl create deployment api --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment frontend --port=80
kubectl expose deployment api --port=80

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: multi-path
spec:
  rules:
  - host: app.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /frontend
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: frontend
            port: { number: 80 }
      - path: /api
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: api
            port: { number: 80 }
EOF

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Secret TLS con certificato self-signed
2. Crea un deployment e Service
3. Configura Ingress con TLS usando il Secret
4. Verifica che TLS sia configurato
exercises.solution:
openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout tls.key -out tls.crt -subj '/CN=app.local/O=test'
kubectl create secret tls app-tls --cert=tls.crt --key=tls.key

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: tls-ingress
spec:
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - app.local
    secretName: app-tls
  rules:
  - host: app.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: web
            port: { number: 80 }
EOF

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment backend
2. Crea una NetworkPolicy che permette traffico solo dai pod con label access: allowed
3. Crea un pod test che può accedere
4. Crea un pod che non può accedere
hints: podSelector seleziona i pod da proteggere
Crea due pod di test con label diversi
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment backend --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment backend --port=80

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: backend-policy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          access: allowed
EOF

kubectl run allowed --image=busybox --labels='access=allowed' --rm -it -- wget -qO- backend
kubectl run denied --image=busybox --labels='access=denied' --rm -it -- wget -qO- backend --timeout=5

exercises.task:
1. Crea namespace dev e prod
2. Crea un Service in prod
3. Crea NetworkPolicy che permette solo da namespace dev
4. Verifica che solo pod in dev possano accedere
exercises.solution:
kubectl create namespace dev
kubectl create namespace prod

kubectl create deployment api -n prod --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment api -n prod --port=80

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ns-policy
  namespace: prod
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  ingress:
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: dev
EOF

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Service headless
2. Verifica che non abbia ClusterIP
3. Controlla che i DNS restituiscano gli IP dei pod
4. Crea un StatefulSet per testare
hints: StatefulSet crea pod con DNS stabili
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  serviceName: web-headless
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-headless
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
  - port: 80
EOF

kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup web-headless

exercises.task:
1. Crea un Service ExternalName per google.com
2. Verifica che punti al nome esterno
3. Testa la risoluzione DNS dal pod
4. Il Service non dovrebbe avere ClusterIP
exercises.solution:
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: google
spec:
  type: ExternalName
  externalName: google.com
EOF

kubectl describe svc google
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- nslookup google

description.it: Bloccare tutto il traffico in ingresso

exercises.task:
1. Crea un deployment esposto
2. Verifica che sia accessibile
3. Applica una NetworkPolicy deny-all
4. Verifica che non sia più accessibile
hints: podSelector matcha i pod da isolare
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment private --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment private --port=80
kubectl run test --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- private

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-all
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: private
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
EOF

kubectl run test2 --image=busybox --rm -it -- wget -qO- private --timeout=5

exercises.task:
1. Crea un pod che può chiamare esterno
2. Crea NetworkPolicy che blocca Egress
3. Verifica che il pod non possa più uscire
4. Permetti solo DNS e specifici IP
exercises.solution:
kubectl run client --image=busybox -- sleep 3600
kubectl exec client -- wget -qO- http://example.com

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: restrict-egress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      run: client
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.96.0.0/12  # Kubernetes services
    - namespaceSelector: {}  # Allow within cluster
  - ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
EOF

kubectl exec client -- wget -qO- http://example.com --timeout=5

exercises.task:
1. Crea deployment frontend, backend, database
2. Crea i rispettivi Service
3. Configura NetworkPolicy per isolamento
4. Frontend può chiamare backend, backend può chiamare db
exercises.solution:
# Frontend
kubectl create deployment frontend --image=nginx --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl expose deployment frontend --port=80

# Backend
kubectl create deployment backend --image=nginx --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl expose deployment backend --port=80

# Database
kubectl create deployment database --image=redis --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl expose deployment database --port=6379

# NetworkPolicies
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: backend-ingress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: frontend
EOF

exercises.task:
1. Crea deployment default-backend
2. Configura Ingress con backend di default
3. Testa un host non configurato
4. Verifica che ritorni il backend di default
hints: Crea un Service per il default backend
Ogni Ingress controller ha configurazione diversa
exercises.solution:
kubectl create deployment default-backend --image=nginx
kubectl expose deployment default-backend --port=80

cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: default-ingress
spec:
  defaultBackend:
    service:
      name: default-backend
      port:
        number: 80
EOF

kubectl get ingress default-ingress
